summary: Dispatch proposal only, not an acceptance claim. Freeze `mapping` as `{version:'migration-mapping-v1',inventory_identity:<sha256>,resolutions:[...]}`. The first preview without a mapping emits stable ambiguities `{id,kind,observed,observed_identity,allowed}`. Each resolution must be `{ambiguity_id,kind,observed,observed_identity,choice,rationale}` with exact equality to that ambiguity's kind/original values/identity, a bounded nonempty rationale, unique complete coverage, and no extra entries. Normalize and hash this object as mapping_hash; preview_id then binds inventory_identity plus mapping_hash and all proposed operations. Permit only these choice forms: actor-alias `{owner:<current canonical self or an explicitly observed actor id>}`; story-owner `{owner:<one mapped/observed owner>}`; story-builder `{builder:'codex-builder'|'expert-builder'}`; story-status `{status:'claimed'|'building'|'built'|'in-review'|'blocked'}` with `in review` normalized before ambiguity detection and no caller-selected merged; story-branch `{branch:<safe branch>}` constrained to an observed branch when candidates exist and to `pm/<story>-*` when genuinely missing; story-metadata `{builder,touches:[<safe bounded paths>]}` only when pm-meta is absent; plan-edit `{after_blob:<oid>,edit_identity:<sha256>,accepted:true}` accepting only the engine-generated removal of the legacy Instruction-rules line and/or addition of the selected Integration branch. Consistent fields produce no ambiguity and therefore cannot be overridden. Counters never appear in mapping and are always per-field MAX of credible observations. Unsupported choice shapes, contradictory originals, stale inventory identities, arbitrary plan replacements, or attempts to select merged fail before a READY preview. `limits` is optional and caller-reducible only: `{max_files<=2000,max_file_bytes<=8388608,max_total_bytes<=67108864,max_refs<=2000,max_stories<=500,max_actors<=500,max_operations<=2500,git_timeout_ms<=10000}` with positive safe integers. Omission uses those production maxima; exceeding any limit returns a located blocking/UNKNOWN preview finding, never partial READY. Use preview_id itself as the journal id and `.deliver/migrations/<preview_id>.json`. Store `version:'migration-journal-v1'`, root/common-repository/HEAD/object-format/basis identities, mapping_hash, ordered typed operations, retained-source identities, attempts/history and status `prepared|applied|rolled-back`. Each operation is `{ordinal,kind:'write'|'remove',path,before,after}` where an image is `{kind:'absent'}` or `{kind:'file',mode:'100644'|'100755',bytes_base64,digest,tracked,index_oid}`; reject symlink/nonregular sources instead of representing them. Validate the whole preview, allowlist and every basis/image before writing the journal. Apply the frozen order: evidence/current artifacts and stories, plan, approval last among writes, exact clean tracked removals, then atomically mark the retained journal applied. Recovery accepts only an incomplete prepared journal whose paths each equal an exact before or after image; resume walks forward, rollback walks backward, and any third image leaves every path unchanged. An applied journal is durable provenance, not an undo command. A rolled-back attempt stays in history and the same restored preview may start another recorded attempt. A rerun with a verified applied journal and exact retained dirty/untracked legacy identities yields a READY `already_applied:true` preview and `applyMigration` returns ALREADY_APPLIED. Suggested CLI is `migrate.mjs preview [--mapping <regular-json>] [--limits <regular-json>]`, `apply --preview <regular-json> --expected-preview <sha256>`, `inspect --id <sha256>`, and `recover --id <sha256> --action resume|rollback`; all use the current Git root, reject stdin/FIFO/symlink/oversize input, print JSON, and never fetch or call providers. This resolves the earlier schema ambiguity without changing migration policy or authorization.
